name: Inspect Existing Floor Protection
intent: Verify that floor protection installed by an earlier trade or earlier phase is still intact and adequate before finish coats begin. Walks the room, checks coverage, re-tapes seams. Skipped when the floor is bare subfloor (no protection to inspect).
doctrine: Inspection is a binary walkthrough, not a quality-tier-driven activity. Rate stays flat across QT. Only fires when the room has finished or partial flooring already in place — bare subfloor rooms have nothing to inspect.
